lines.beaver: 여보세요, 민지 씨? 꽃집은 잘 찾았어요?
lines.beaver_en: Hello, Minji? Did you find the flower shop okay?
lines.beaver_roman: yeoboseyo, minji ssi? kkotjibeun jal chajasseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 알려 주신 대로 가니까 바로 찾았어요.
lines.en: Yes, I went just as you told me and found it right away.
lines.roman: ne, allyeo jusin daero ganikka baro chajasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Was it easy to cross the main street?
lines.learner: 네, 대로를 건너서 인도를 따라 쭉 걸었어요.
lines.en: Yes, I crossed the main street and walked along the sidewalk.
lines.roman: ne, daeroreul geonneoseo indoreul ttara jjuk georeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Was the sign easy to see?
lines.learner: 네, 말씀하신 대로 파란 표지판이 있었어요.
lines.en: Yes, there was a blue sign, just as you said.
lines.roman: ne, malsseumhasin daero paran pyojipani isseosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then you turned into the alley on the right?
lines.en: Yes, I went into the alley next to the sign.

lines.learner: 조금 어두웠지만 가로등이 켜져 있어서 괜찮았어요.
lines.en: It was a bit dark, but the streetlights were on, so it was fine.
lines.roman: jogeum eoduwotjiman garodeungi kyeojyeo isseoseo gwaenchanasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: There was a bakery at the end of the alley, right?
lines.learner: 네, 길가에 빵집이 있었어요. 냄새가 좋았어요.
lines.en: Yes, there was a bakery by the roadside. It smelled good.
lines.roman: ne, gilgae ppangjibi isseosseoyo. naemsaega joasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: The flower shop is right next to that bakery.
lines.learner: 네, 들은 대로 빵집 옆에 꽃집이 있었어요.
lines.en: Yes, just as I heard, the flower shop was next to the bakery.
lines.roman: ne, deureun daero ppangjip yeope kkotjibi isseosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Did you buy flowers you liked?
lines.learner: 네, 생각한 대로 예쁜 꽃을 샀어요.
lines.en: Yes, I bought pretty flowers, just as I had in mind.
lines.roman: ne, saenggakan daero yeppeun kkocheul sasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: If you don't know the way next time, just ask anytime.
lines.learner: 고마워요. 그려 주신 대로 따라가서 쉬웠어요.
lines.en: Thank you. It was easy because I followed what you drew.
lines.roman: gomawoyo. geuryeo jusin daero ttaragaseo swiwosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: I'm glad it helped. Get home safely.
lines.learner: 네, 감사해요. 내일 꽃 보여 드릴게요.
lines.en: Okay, thank you. I'll show you the flowers tomorrow.
lines.roman: ne, gamsahaeyo. naeil kkot boyeo deurilgeyo.
